workload.note: 9 games/9 starts for Jets. Passing: 128/204, 1,259 yds, 7 TD, 1 INT. Rushing: 383 yds, 4 TD (pro-football-reference). 2-7 record as starter.

scheme.note: CONFIRMED TEAM CHANGE: Fields was traded from the Jets to the Chiefs in the 2026 offseason for a 2027 6th-round pick (Yahoo Sports, May 8, 2026). Also note: Chiefs OC changed for 2026 - Eric Bieniemy returns as KC OC for his 6th stint in that role (11th season with org overall), after coaching Bears RBs in 2025 and UCLA in 2024, per chiefs.com staff bio. HC Andy Reid continues (14th season).

competition.name: Patrick Mahomes
competition.note: Entrenched starter; Fields is clear backup/QB2.

notes: arrowheadaddict.com (Jun 3, 2026) depth chart: QB1 Mahomes, QB2 Fields, QB3 Garrett Nussmeier (rookie), QB4 Chris Oladokun (practice squad since 2022).
Andy Reid quoted describing Fields as a 'legitimate starting quarterback' who could win games early in the season if Mahomes were unavailable (NFL.com/ESPN, May 2026).

injury.note: No injury reported for Fields as of Aug 11, 2026 in sources checked.

camp.quote: Fields wanted to join Chiefs to learn from Patrick Mahomes, Andy Reid.
